title: Wall
description:
One segment chain of a `Map`'s vision and movement mesh.

Walls are what make line of sight work: each is a polyline whose `type` says whether it stops
vision, movement, or both. Doors additionally carry a `door` state that can change during
play, so opening one changes what the party can see.

Unlike the other map objects a wall is a plain `Codable` value, not a Realm object — the whole
mesh is stored encoded in `Map/walls` because a detailed map carries thousands of segments
and they are always loaded together. The derived geometry (`points`, `path`, `hitPath`,
wall segments) is cached and must be discarded with `invalidate()` after editing `data`.

- SeeAlso: `Map/walls`, `Map/lineOfSight`, `WallType`

id.description:
The unique identifier for this wall.

A UUID string generated when the wall is created.

data.description:
The wall's vertices, as a flat list of alternating x and y coordinates.

Stored flat rather than as points to keep the encoded mesh compact.

## Examples
- `[100, 200, 340, 200]` — a single segment from (100, 200) to (340, 200)

- Note: Edit through `update(_:)`, which also invalidates the cached geometry.
- SeeAlso: `points`

color.description:
An override for the color the wall is drawn in while editing.

Defaults to the color of its `type` when absent.

type.description:
What this wall blocks.

`nil` behaves as `WallType/normal`.

- SeeAlso: `WallType`

side.description: Which side of the wall blocks; `nil` behaves as `Side/both`.

door.description:
The door's state, for walls of type `WallType/door` or `WallType/secretDoor`.

- SeeAlso: `DoorState`

generated.description:
Whether this wall was produced by automatic wall detection rather than drawn by hand.

Lets generated walls be cleared in bulk without disturbing the user's own.

Side.title: Side
Side.description:
Which side of a wall blocks.

A one-sided wall lets a creature see out but not in — useful for balconies, cliff edges and
one-way windows.

DoorState.title: DoorState
DoorState.description: The state of a door wall.
